name: Fiendish Confidence
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 220, Faiths of Corruption pg. 5
body:
Drawbacks
Fiendish Confidence
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 220, Faiths of Corruption pg. 5
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Asmodeus
You expect to be obeyed, and are rarely proven wrong. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Intimidate checks, and Intimidate is a class skill for you.
